analysis.analysis: R-001 contains multiple distinct behaviors: adding a new bookmark and placing it into a specific location within the hierarchy. R-002 contains multiple behaviors: deleting bookmarks from the bookmarks file and removing their display from all access points. R-003 contains multiple behaviors: adding bookmarks to the personal toolbar and deleting bookmarks from the personal toolbar. R-004 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion for inserting a new bookmark folder into the hierarchy. R-005 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion for launching a bookmark in a browser window upon double-clicking. R-006 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion ensuring bookmarks in the default file are valid links. R-007 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion for saving changes without loss of integrity. R-008 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion for deleting a bookmarks folder. R-009 contains multiple behaviors: adding bookmarks separators and deleting bookmarks separators. R-010 contains multiple behaviors: saving changes over restart and saving changes over crash. R-011 mentions negative conditions and contains multiple behaviors for executing view properties on bookmarks, folders, and separators. R-012 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion for inline renaming. R-013 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion for finding bookmarks using a custom keyword. R-014 contains multiple behaviors: sorting bookmarks per column and reverse-sorting bookmarks per column. R-015 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion for resizing bookmark columns. R-016 contains multiple behaviors: showing bookmark columns and hiding bookmark columns. R-017 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion for deleting several bookmarks at one time. R-018 contains multiple abnormal/error behaviors and boundary conditions for dropping a bookmark onto itself, its immediate parent, or its immediate child.
